findings.fix: Add USER nonroot before the CMD/ENTRYPOINT line.

FROM ubuntu:22.04

FROM ubuntu:22.04

findings.detail: Possible secret found in ENV: DB_PASSWORD=admin123
findings.fix: Use Docker secrets or environment variables at runtime instead.
findings.good_code:
ARG DB_PASSWORD
ENV DB_PASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD
# pass at runtime: docker run -e DB_PASSWORD=xxx
findings.why: Secrets in ENV are visible in docker inspect, image history, and any registry.

findings.detail: Port 22 is exposed. Containers should not allow SSH access.
findings.good_code:
EXPOSE 80
# never expose port 22
findings.why: SSH inside containers expands attack surface and violates container design principles.

findings.rule: Rule 4 — ADD used instead of COPY
findings.detail: ADD instruction found: https://example.com/app.tar.gz /app
findings.fix: Replace ADD with COPY unless you specifically need URL fetching.
findings.good_code:
COPY ./src /app
# use COPY for local files always
findings.why: ADD can fetch remote URLs and auto-extract archives creating unexpected attack surface.

findings.detail: Unpinned or :latest tag used: ubuntu:latest
findings.fix: Pin to a specific version e.g. nginx:1.25.3
findings.good_code:
FROM nginx:1.25.3
FROM python:3.11.7-slim
findings.why: Supply chain attacks can replace :latest with a malicious image silently.

findings.detail: No HEALTHCHECK instruction found.
findings.fix: Add HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -f http://localhost/ || exit 1
findings.good_code:
FROM nginx:1.25.3
COPY . /app
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD curl -f http://localhost/ || exit 1
findings.why: Without health checks, crashed containers keep running causing silent denial of service.

findings.detail: apt-get install used without --no-install-recommends.
findings.bad_code: RUN apt-get install curl vim git
findings.good_code: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl
findings.why: Extra packages expand attack surface with unnecessary tools and libraries.

findings.detail: Downloading and executing scripts directly is dangerous.
findings.fix: Download first, verify checksum, then execute separately.
findings.good_code:
RUN curl -o install.sh https://get.docker.com \
  && sha256sum install.sh \
  && bash install.sh
findings.why: A compromised server can deliver malware silently through piped execution.

findings.detail: apt-get install used without apt-get update in same RUN.
findings.fix: Use RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y <package>
findings.good_code:
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
findings.why: Stale package cache may install outdated vulnerable package versions.

findings.detail: No WORKDIR instruction found. Files may land in root filesystem.
findings.fix: Add WORKDIR /app before your COPY and RUN instructions.
findings.bad_code:
FROM node:18
COPY . .
RUN npm install
findings.good_code:
FROM node:18
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install
findings.why: Without WORKDIR files land in root directory making auditing harder.

FROM nginx:1.25.3
